summary: To use an execution environment in a job template, build it, push it to a registry, and create it under Automation Execution > Infrastructure > Execution Environments with a name and full image path; organization-scoped EEs need org admin rights and EE credentials need username, host and password.
questions: How do I add a custom execution environment to automation controller?
Do I need to push my execution environment to a registry?
Who can use an execution environment tied to an organization?
What image name format does an execution environment need?
